text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, while walking through 
academy—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Sleepy... Training went late yesterday 
too, so figures—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOOHHHH!!!! Cheer up, Taishiiiiiin!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what the...?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey Taishin! Do you know about musical 
called "Hundred Beast Kingdom"?!?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
A musical, a musical!! Wanna perform it 
together with us?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, not doing that... What is this all of 
a sudden—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—A musical. It is well suited for physical 
conditioning. Wanna try right now?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Hayahide, what are you saying too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: A fun way to exercise, huh...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin, you often train all by yourself 
at night, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that lonely and boring? I thought 
doing musical together would be super fun!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Musicals require diverse performance 
skills such as singing, dancing, and 
acting.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Not only ideal for full-body exercise, it 
serves as practice for live performances. 
Logically worthwhile, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Nah, sorry, pass. Not good with that 
stuff. Go ahead, just you two.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then allow us to demonstrate 
first.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right! Watch closely, Taishin! Let's 
give it our all, Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Music, STAAART!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Eh? ...Doing it right here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket and Biwa Hayahide's dance 
continued for a while—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft, what is this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide, doing musical with such sour 
face...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Pff... Ahaha! That's trying way too 
hard... Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaahhhhh~~~~!! Taishin 
smilleeeed~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Eh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! We did it, Ticket! Operation 
success!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Op-Operation...? What are you talking 
about...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! You looked exhausted all the time 
lately, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So Hayahide and I were thinking how we 
could cheer you up!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
How was it? Made you feel much better, 
right?!?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Wait. That means—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
All that musical nonsense was just 
setup...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Essentially, yes. But seeing your smile 
brings me relief.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, great smile, Taishin!! Seeing 
you smile makes me so happy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ~~~~... Urgh! Got played...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
J-Just so you know, recorded video! 
Including Hayahide's deadpan dance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Maybe show it to your little sister. 
...Wonder how she'll react.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?! Wait! Please, not to Brian...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, yay! Both Taishin and Hayahide 
having fun now~♪
